d:
Canva is restructuring, affecting 1,271 employees. But its exit package is turning heads. Six months' salary, free MacBooks, healthcare and even $10,000 startup grants. Why is the design giant cutting jobs? Hem Kaur Saroya breaks down the layoffs, AI disruption and the future of tech jobs.
